name: The Aquarium of Sodomy
source:
I was terribly comfortable in the water.
The moment I sank into the blue, I knew this was where I belonged.
But on that day, I breathed my last breath into you.
Your once-dead heartbeat came back to life as you gazed at me.

Ah, so where I truly belong is...

[translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130910233250/http://luxe.o0o0.jp/sodomy/story.html]official website[/url]]
